J1 ORACLE PROVENANCE (epic AC8 / this story's AC2): the characterization oracles that pin every unit J2 moves were written and LANDED BEFORE any code moved.
 - J1 = acb2-1823-2f0d-415b (newborn-avian-civet), 'freeze the Cloud adapter's behavior with characterization oracles before anything moves'.
 - Its Gerrit change: 1009 — https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1009 — MERGED, having earned LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. It is commit 7fc96b277, which is the parent this story is stacked on.
 - It took tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_backend_characterization.py from 9 to 30 tests, adding exact-value pins for map_fields_to_remote's five branches (incl. both value-map defaults), the sanitizer boundaries on both sides of the deliberate 254/255 off-by-one, all four label rejection reasons, the identity convention, the probe classifier's branches, and the link vocabulary.
 - Across J2 that oracle changed by EXACTLY ONE line — an import re-point for _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK — with ZERO assertions modified.

PROCESS NOTE (recorded honestly rather than glossed): this comment was added a few minutes AFTER the push of change 1010, not before it. The AC's substance holds — J1 was merged well beforehand and its change number was known and cited in the session log — but the AC words the ordering as 'recorded ... before this story is pushed for review', and strictly the comment landed just after. Flagging it rather than back-dating.

J2 PUSHED FOR REVIEW: change 1010 — https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1010 (stacked on 1009/7fc96b277).
